headline: Viviana Power Tech wins Rs 139.49 crore PGVCL order for underground cabling
summary: Viviana Power Tech secured a Rs 139.49 crore order from PGVCL for underground cable network conversion in Rajkot. This adds to its existing order book, bringing Q2FY27 inflow to Rs 537.16 crore across five orders.

headline: ABFRL subsidiary fully acquires Urbano brand owner
summary: Aditya Birla Fashion & Retail Ltd's digital arm ABDFVL has acquired the remaining 15.62% stake in Imperial Online Services, maker of Urbano. The move makes Imperial a wholly owned subsidiary.

headline: Grauer & Weil declares ₹0.50 dividend at AGM
summary: Grauer & Weil (India) Ltd held its 68th AGM on September 17, 2026. The company declared a dividend of Re 0.50 per share for FY26 and approved director reappointments.

headline: Stocks to Watch: Wipro, GPT Infra, Captain Polyplast
summary: Wipro launches AI solutions; GPT Infraprojects wins big Odisha bridge deal. Captain Polyplast rallies on solar order. Check key moves.

headline: Skyways Air Services hires Adfactors PR for relations
summary: Skyways Air Services has engaged Adfactors PR to handle its public and investor relations, marking a strategic communications appointment for the company.

headline: Wheels India shareholders approve preferential issue
summary: Wheels India Limited secured overwhelming shareholder approval for a preferential equity issue and enhanced fund-raising limits at its EGM on September 17, 2026.

headline: Zim Laboratories sets up Chile subsidiary for LATAM push
summary: Zim Laboratories Ltd incorporated ZIM Laboratories SpA in Chile as a wholly owned subsidiary to expand its pharmaceutical business in the Latin American region.

headline: Asian Paints starts production at new VAE emulsion plant
summary: Asian Paints has commenced production at its new 1.5 lakh TPA Vinyl Acetate Ethylene Emulsion plant located in Dahej, marking a significant manufacturing milestone.

headline: Dr Reddy's signs licensing deal with Gilead for HIV drug
summary: Dr Reddy's Laboratories has agreed to a licensing deal with Gilead Sciences for once-yearly lenacapavir, a drug used to prevent HIV.

headline: Global chipmakers accelerate India semiconductor push
summary: Global chipmakers are intensifying their focus on India, with fabs, advanced packaging, and power electronics emerging as key growth engines, drawing attention to players like CG Power, Kaynes Tech, Moschip Tech, and Dixon Tech.

headline: Dr. Reddy's signs exclusive deal with Takeda for Qdenga vaccine in India
summary: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories has entered an exclusive distribution agreement with Takeda for Qdenga, India's first approved dengue vaccine. The partnership targets the private market, with availability expected in H1 2027.

headline: Sky Gold acquires Purvi Gems for up to ₹9 crore
summary: Sky Gold & Diamonds Ltd approved the acquisition of 100% stake in Purvi Gems & Jewellery (India) Private Limited for a cash consideration of up to ₹9 crore. The target entity reported a turnover of ₹103.40 crore in FY26.

headline: Indian rupee opens stronger at 95.7125 vs dollar
summary: The Indian rupee opened at 95.7125 against the US dollar, strengthening from the previous close of 95.93, reflecting a firmer start to the trading session.

headline: India 10-year bond yield rises to 7.07%
summary: India's 10-year benchmark government bond yield rose to 7.0686% from the previous close of 7.0463%, reflecting an uptick in yields.

headline: Copper rallies on returning Chinese buyer demand
summary: Copper prices rallied as returning Chinese buyers boosted demand and supported global metal prices, benefiting Indian metal companies including Hindustan Copper and Hindalco Industries.

headline: Govt upgrades cotton testing labs to boost textile quality
summary: The government is upgrading cotton testing laboratories to strengthen textile hubs, improve quality standards, and enhance export competitiveness, according to a newspaper report.

headline: EU duty-free access may boost Indian steel exports
summary: Wider duty-free access to the European Union ahead of a potential India-EU free trade agreement could boost Indian steel exports and support domestic steel producers, according to a newspaper report.

headline: Tata Electronics signs 7 MoUs at semiconductor event
summary: Tata Electronics signed 7 MoUs as Applied Materials committed $5 billion to accelerate India's semiconductor ecosystem, marking a significant push for domestic chip manufacturing.

headline: SP Group eyes partial monetisation of Tata Sons stake
summary: SP Group has proposed monetising part of its 18.37% stake in Tata Sons, with Noel Tata placing the proposal before the board, according to a newspaper report.

headline: Kaynes Technology eyes $1-billion OSAT expansion
summary: Kaynes Technology India plans a $1-billion OSAT expansion and targets ₹250-300 crore in semiconductor revenue under its Semicon 2.0 initiative, per a newspaper report.

headline: IndiGo raises fees for baggage, infants and more
summary: IndiGo has increased charges for extra baggage, infant travel, unaccompanied minors, and Fast Forward services, affecting passengers across its network.

headline: RBL Bank meets Balyasny Asset Management
summary: RBL Bank held a one-on-one investor meet with Balyasny Asset Management on September 17, 2026. The bank confirmed no unpublished price-sensitive information was shared during the video conference.

headline: BEML wins ₹5,400 crore deal from NHSRCL
summary: BEML has secured a ₹5,400 crore contract from NHSRCL for high-speed train supply and maintenance for the Mumbai-Ahmedabad rail corridor.

headline: Beml bags Rs 5400 crore NHSRCL bullet train order
summary: Beml has received an Ultra-Mega order worth Rs 5400 crore from National High Speed Rail Corporation Limited for supply and maintenance of high speed rolling stock for the Mumbai Ahmedabad High Speed Rail Corridor.

headline: Moody's sees India outpacing G-20 peers in growth
summary: Moody's has predicted that India's economic growth will outpace other G-20 nations and similar emerging markets, reinforcing its position as a leading growth economy.

headline: Parag Milk Foods appoints Phalgun Trivedi as R&D chief
summary: Parag Milk Foods has appointed Phalgun Trivedi as its new head of R&D, quality control, and food safety. Trivedi brings experience from Unilever, Coca-Cola India, Parle Agro, and H.J. Heinz.

headline: Mazagon Dock Plans ₹15,000 Cr Capex
summary: Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders plans to invest nearly ₹15,000 crore in shipyard development. The company aims for 15-17% returns on investments and expects a P75I order this month.

headline: Bharat Petroleum to host investor meet on Sep 24
summary: Bharat Petroleum Corporation Ltd will host a physical investor meeting with UBS Securities in Kochi on September 24, 2026, at 2:30 pm. The session is scheduled under SEBI Regulation 30.
